observed_in: Religion and God System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the types and impacts of rewards granted to players for their piety and adherence to a deity's tenets. Variations can include passive bonuses, unique abilities, or even temporary boosts based on the player's actions and the deity's preferences.
exclusion_criteria: Rewards are not purely cosmetic or aesthetic in nature.
This dimension does not include penalties or restrictions imposed by the deity.
inclusion_criteria: Rewards can be passive or active abilities granted by a deity.
Rewards vary based on the player's level of piety or specific actions taken.
title: Favor Rewards in Religion Systems
